appUrl.description: The app's public origin, no trailing slash.

prefix.description: A DNS label short enough for `-builds`/`-egress` to fit in 63 characters.

workloadValue.description: 0 or more: the reserved-capacity rungs are fixed at -10 … -1, and real work must outrank every one.

toolHostValue.description: 0 or more: the reserved-capacity rungs are fixed at -10 … -1, and real work must outrank every one.

not.description: Every selector given is empty: that peer is every pod. An empty namespaceSelector is every pod in every namespace; a lone empty podSelector is every pod in the policy's own namespace. Name the database's pods by labels.

peers.description: NetworkPolicy peers (namespaceSelector and/or podSelector) added to every database rule: a Postgres inside the cluster that an operator runs.

extraIngress.description: A rule without `from` admits every source: each must name its peers.

extraEgress.description: A rule without `to` reaches every destination: each must name its peers.

lockTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a migration waits for another pod's lock before its pod fails and is retried (RYPH_MIGRATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT).

not.description: No ipBlock, and every selector given is empty: that peer is every pod. An empty namespaceSelector is every pod in every namespace; a lone empty podSelector is every pod in the policy's own namespace (the runs, for a run policy). Name the pods or namespaces by labels, same-namespace peers included.
